exitAfterOutput.text: This calls [[exit]] on a path that [[pending]]. [[why]] [[repair]]

pending.TypeScript: has already written to stdout or stderr in this function
pending.Go: has already deferred a call in this function

why.TypeScript: `process.exit()` ends the process without waiting for writes still in flight, and a write to a pipe can be one: a reader piping this command (`| grep`, `execSync`, a spawned child) gets the output cut at 64 KB, with exit status 0 and no error.
why.Go: `{{call}}` ends the process at once and runs no deferred call, so a `defer writer.Flush()` or `defer file.Close()` above it never happens: the buffered output is lost, or the file is left half written, and nothing says so.

repair.TypeScript: Set `process.exitCode = n` and return instead, so the process ends on its own once the output has drained.
repair.Go: Return the error or the exit code instead, and exit in `main` once every deferred call has run, as `os.Exit(run())` does when `run` holds the defers.
